Book correction: The book prints "define by". It should read "defined by": consider the function f : \mathbb{R} \to [-1, 1] defined by f(x) = \sin x. (The same slip is repeated at the start of 9.1.2 and 9.1.3.)

Book correction: The book prints "is also obtain by reflecting"; it should be "is also obtained by reflecting". It then prints "Observe that the graph of y = \sin x is symmetric about the line y = x". The graph of y = \sin x on its own is not symmetric about y = x.
